ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 75% low-intensity dark pigment and 25% high-intensity white pigment located primarily at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark central region with symmetric high-intensity white patches on both the left and right distal tips. Left white region contains a distinct high-intensity yellow-tan sub-patch at the interior boundary. Fine-grained high-intensity speckling is distributed across the lower-central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle approximately between 35 and 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged topography with high-amplitude serrations, particularly pronounced along the upper margins and heavily distorted by biological encrustations on the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward sweep transitioning to sharp upward trajectories at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive high-contrast clusters of circular and conical biological encrustations (barnacles) densely packed along the entire outer lateral edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally and vertically across the central dark pigmentation zone, with the highest concentration in the lower central quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological colonization by sessile organisms along the perimeter; multiple parallel and intersecting white linear scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-tan staining or biofouling on the upper interior portion of the left lobe's white distal patch.
